- Sell-to-buy ratio of 0.92 in the first two minutes after graduation, with net outflow of -7.6 SOL over the last 15 minutes and 208 sellers against 176 buyers.
- Pool depth of 53.5 SOL is thin. On a $20 ticket, the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost is inflated by price impact, and exit liquidity is poor if the slide continues.
